card.name: Words that precede a location term
card.fires_on: Words just before a body-site or place word, such as 'of' in 'much of Asia', 'genital' before bleeding, or the middle of 'intrathecal' and 'intravesical'. It also fires on 'the' in 'off the Coast'.

modes.label: Inside intra- route words
modes.description: Partway through 'intrathecal' or 'intravesical' before the ending.
modes.example: Cytarabine given intrat<<hec>>ally may cause systemic toxicity

modes.label: Linking word before a place
modes.description: A small word like 'of' or 'the' that leads into a place name or region.
modes.example: Earthquake off<< the>> Coast of Venezuela

modes.label: Body-site modifier
modes.description: An adjective or noun that sits before a bleeding or imaging term and names a body site or position.
